# API_GATEWAY

An ingress a workload attaches an HTTPRoute to, and the zone its hostnames live in.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix from nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `gateway`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.gateway`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.
